### When Anger Destroys
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/when-anger-destroys
Passage: 1 Samuel 25:39a
Points:
- Anger is a volatile emotion that easily spirals out of control into sinful vengeance.
- Biblical justice restricts retribution so that punishment never exceeds the actual offense.
- Unrestrained wrath brings heavy consequences, as when Simeon and Levi forfeited their family leadership.
- God mercifully restrained David from bloodshed through Abigail, preserving him from self-destruction.
- Believers must renounce personal payback and trust God instead of acting on retaliatory impulses.
